## VIX term structure and option volume {#vix-volatility-index-term-structure}

The data is downloaded from the [Taiwan Futures Exchange](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/3/dlOptDailyMarketView). Select a trading date to see its VIX term structure and option volume. Liquidity by strike groups the selected expiration’s trades into 500-point bins. Within its traded strike range, the right axis shows the nearest TXF-based IV curve for that day. Each IV point represents a put or call that traded at that strike in the curve’s own expiration. The VIX methodology is based on Cboe VIX, see [Cboe Volatility Index Mathematics Methodology](https://cdn.cboe.com/resources/indices/Cboe_Volatility_Index_Mathematics_Methodology.pdf).

Our VIX estimate excludes end-of-day option quotes when the best ask exceeds the best bid by more than 50 index points **and** is more than 10 times the bid. Volume includes both sessions.

## Market history {#front-expiry-vix-vs-taiex}

Each window ends on the latest shared trading day. The [TAIFEX put/call ratios](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/3/pcRatio) show total puts divided by total calls as a percentage. Closing open interest excludes contracts settled that day.

## IV (Implied Volatility) Curves

The top row shows the two nearest eligible expirations matched to TAIEX futures (TXF). The bottom row uses Mini-TAIEX futures (MXF). Both date sliders select the same trading day. Each point is a Black-76 IV from an out-of-the-money option settlement price and a futures contract with the same expiration.

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const plotlyReady = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/plotly.js-finance-dist-min@4.1.1/plotly-finance.min.js";
    script.async = true;
    script.onload = resolve;
    script.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Plotly could not be loaded"));
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });

  const user = "siang-dai";
  const repo = "txo-vix-iv";

  const rawRoot =
    `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${user}/${repo}/main`;

  const rawOutput = `${rawRoot}/output`;
  const rawData = `${rawRoot}/data`;

  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // VIX interactive term structure + option volume
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  const chart =
    document.getElementById("vix-term-chart");

  const status =
    document.getElementById("vix-status");

  const slider =
    document.getElementById("vix-date-slider");

  const dateSelect = document.getElementById("vix-history-date");
  const dateControls = ["vix", "iv"].map(id => ({
    select: document.getElementById(id + "-history-date"),
    prev: document.getElementById(id + "-prev-date"),
    next: document.getElementById(id + "-next-date")
  }));

  const startLabel =
    document.getElementById("vix-start-date");

  const selectedLabel =
    document.getElementById("vix-selected-date");

  const endLabel =
    document.getElementById("vix-end-date");

  const volumeChart =
    document.getElementById("vix-volume-chart");

  const volumeStatus =
    document.getElementById("vix-volume-status");

  const expirySelect = document.getElementById("liquidity-expiration");
  const liquidityChart = document.getElementById("liquidity-chart");
  const liquidityStatus = document.getElementById("liquidity-status");
  const ivSlider = document.getElementById("iv-date-slider");
  const ivSides = [
    { key: "puts", name: "Put", color: "#d78328", tint: "#e4ab6d", symbol: "circle" },
    { key: "calls", name: "Call", color: "#297fb8", tint: "#6da8cf", symbol: "square" }
  ];

  function parseCsv(text) {
    const lines = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
    const headers = lines[0].split(",");

    return lines
      .slice(1)
      .map(line => {
        const values = line.split(",");

        const row = Object.fromEntries(
          headers.map((header, i) => [
            header.trim(),
            values[i] ?? ""
          ])
        );

        return {
          Date: String(row.Date || "").trim(),
          Expiration_Month: String(row.Expiration_Month || "").trim(),
          Expiration_Date: String(row.Expiration_Date || "").trim(),
          Days_to_Exp: row.Days_to_Exp?.trim() ? Number(row.Days_to_Exp) : NaN,
          Forward: Number(row.Forward),
          VIX: row.VIX?.trim() ? Number(row.VIX) : NaN
        };
      })
      .filter(row =>
        row.Date &&
        Number.isFinite(row.Days_to_Exp) && row.Days_to_Exp >= 0 &&
        Number.isFinite(row.VIX)
      );
  }

  function parseVolumeCsv(text) {
    if (!text || !text.trim()) {
      return [];
    }

    const lines = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
    const headers = lines[0].split(",");

    return lines
      .slice(1)
      .map(line => {
        const values = line.split(",");

        const row = Object.fromEntries(
          headers.map((header, i) => [
            header.trim(),
            values[i] ?? ""
          ])
        );

        return {
          Date: String(row.Date || "").trim(),
          Expiration_Month: String(row.Expiration_Month || "").trim(),
          Expiration_Date: row.Expiration_Date?.trim(),
          First_Strike_Bin: row.First_Strike_Bin?.trim() ? Number(row.First_Strike_Bin) : NaN,
          Call_Bins_500: row.Call_Bins_500?.trim(),
          Put_Bins_500: row.Put_Bins_500?.trim(),
          traded: Object.fromEntries(ivSides.map(side => {
            const field = row[side.name + "_Traded_Strikes"]?.trim();
            const strikes = field && field !== "-" ? field.split(/\s+/).map(Number) : [];
            return [side.key, new Set(strikes)];
          })),
          ...Object.fromEntries(["Call_Volume", "Put_Volume", "Call_OI", "Put_OI"].map(key =>
            [key, row[key]?.trim() ? Number(row[key]) : NaN]
          ))
        };
      })
      .filter(row =>
        row.Date &&
        row.Expiration_Month && row.Expiration_Date &&
        ["Call_Volume", "Put_Volume", "Call_OI", "Put_OI"].every(key => Number.isFinite(row[key]))
      );
  }

  function renderEmptyHistoryChart(element, title, message) {
    ObservatoryCharts.react(element, [], {
      title: { text: title },
      xaxis: { visible: false },
      yaxis: { visible: false },
      annotations: [{
        text: message, x: 0.5, y: 0.5,
        xref: "paper", yref: "paper", showarrow: false
      }],
      margin: { l: 16, r: 16, t: 12, b: 16 },
      showlegend: false
    }, { responsive: true, displayModeBar: false, displaylogo: false });
  }

  function renderTermStructure(daily, date) {
    if (!daily.length) {
      renderEmptyHistoryChart(chart, `TXO VIX Term Structure — ${date}`,
        "No VIX data recorded for this date.");
      status.textContent = `Trading date: ${date} · No VIX data available.`;
      return;
    }

    const bodyColor =
      getComputedStyle(document.body).color;

    const trace = {
      type: "scatter",
      mode: "lines+markers",
      x: daily.map(row => row.Days_to_Exp),
      y: daily.map(row => row.VIX),
      text: daily.map(row => row.Expiration_Month),
      customdata: daily.map(row => [
        row.Expiration_Date,
        row.Forward
      ]),
      hovertemplate:
        "<b>%{text}</b>" +
        "<br>Expiration: %{customdata[0]}" +
        "<br>Days to expiration: %{x:.0f}" +
        "<br>VIX: %{y:.2f}%" +
        "<br>Implied forward: %{customdata[1]:,.2f}" +
        "<extra></extra>",
      line: {
        width: 2.4
      },
      marker: {
        size: 8
      }
    };

    const layout = {
      title: {
        text: `TXO VIX Term Structure — ${date}`,
        x: 0.5
      },
      xaxis: {
        title: "Days to expiration",
        rangemode: "tozero",
        gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.22)"
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: "Estimated VIX",
        ticksuffix: "%",
        gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.22)"
      },
      margin: {
        l: 70,
        r: 25,
        t: 70,
        b: 42
      },
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font: {
        color: bodyColor
      },
      hovermode: "closest",
      showlegend: false,
      autosize: true
    };

    ObservatoryCharts.react(
      chart,
      [trace],
      layout,
      {
        responsive: true,
        displaylogo: false,
        scrollZoom: false
      }
    );

    status.textContent = `${daily.length} expirations`;
  }

  function renderVolume(daily, date) {
    if (!daily.length) {
      renderEmptyHistoryChart(volumeChart, "Option volume by expiration",
        "No option-volume data recorded for this date.");

      volumeStatus.textContent =
        `No option-volume data available for ${date}.`;

      return;
    }

    const bodyColor =
      getComputedStyle(document.body).color;

    const traces = ["Call", "Put"].map(side => ({
      type: "bar", name: side, x: daily.map(row => row.Expiration_Month),
      y: daily.map(row => row[side + "_Volume"]),
      hovertemplate: `%{x}<br>${side}: %{y:,.0f} contracts<extra></extra>`
    }));

    const layout = {
      title: {
        text: "Option volume by expiration",
        x: 0.5,
        font: {
          size: 18
        }
      },
      xaxis: {
        title: "Expiration",
        type: "category",
        categoryorder: "array",
        categoryarray: daily.map(row => row.Expiration_Month),
        automargin: true
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: "Contracts",
        rangemode: "tozero",
        tickformat: ",",
        gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.18)",
        automargin: true
      },
      margin: {
        l: 80,
        r: 30,
        t: 60,
        b: 46
      },
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font: {
        color: bodyColor
      },
      barmode: "group",
      showlegend: true,
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 1, xanchor: "right", y: 1, yanchor: "top", bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)" },
      hovermode: "closest",
      autosize: true
    };

    ObservatoryCharts.react(
      volumeChart,
      traces,
      layout,
      {
        responsive: true,
        displaylogo: false,
        scrollZoom: false
      }
    );

    const totalVolume = daily.reduce(
      (sum, row) => sum + row.Call_Volume + row.Put_Volume,
      0
    );

    volumeStatus.textContent =
      `${totalVolume.toLocaleString()} contracts`;
  }

  function renderLiquidity(row, date, curve, curveVolume, loading) {
    const binOrigin = row?.First_Strike_Bin;
    const counts = ivSides.map(side => row?.[side.name + "_Bins_500"]?.split(/\s+/).map(Number) ?? []);
    const complete = Number.isSafeInteger(binOrigin) && binOrigin >= 0 && binOrigin % 500 === 0 &&
      counts[0].length > 0 && counts[0].length === counts[1].length &&
      counts.every((values, i) => values.every(n => Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0) &&
        values.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 0) === row[ivSides[i].name + "_Volume"] &&
        (row.traded[ivSides[i].key].size > 0) === (row[ivSides[i].name + "_Volume"] > 0));
    if (!complete) {
      liquidityStatus.textContent = `No strike-volume data available for ${date}.`;
      liquidityChart.hidden = true;
      return;
    }

    const traded = [...row.traded.puts, ...row.traded.calls];
    if (!traded.length) {
      liquidityStatus.textContent = `${date} · No trades for ${row.Expiration_Month}.`;
      liquidityChart.hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    liquidityChart.hidden = false;
    const minStrike = Math.min(...traded), maxStrike = Math.max(...traded);
    const first = Math.floor(minStrike / 500) * 500;
    const end = Math.floor(maxStrike / 500) * 500 + 500;
    const startBin = (first - binOrigin) / 500, endBin = (end - binOrigin) / 500;
    const strikes = Array.from({ length: endBin - startBin }, (_, i) => first + i * 500);
    const intervals = strikes.map(start => `[${start.toLocaleString("en-US")}, ${(start + 500).toLocaleString("en-US")})`);
    const lines = [];
    for (const side of ivSides) {
      const points = curve?.[side.key].filter(([strike]) => strike >= minStrike && strike <= maxStrike &&
        curveVolume?.traded[side.key].has(strike));
      if (!points?.length) continue;
      lines.push({
        type: "scatter", mode: "lines+markers", name: `OTM ${side.name.toLowerCase()} IV`,
        x: points.map(p => p[0]), y: points.map(p => p[1]), legendrank: 3 + lines.length,
        line: { color: side.tint, width: 2 }, marker: { color: side.tint, size: 3 },
        hovertemplate: `TXF ${curve.futures_contract} · %{x:,.0f}<br>${side.name} IV: %{y:.2f}%<extra></extra>`
      });
    }
    // Plotly paints the overlay axis after the base axis. Keep volumes in front of IV.
    const bars = ivSides.map((side, i) => ({
      type: "bar", name: side.name + " volume", marker: { color: side.color }, legendrank: i,
      x: strikes.map(start => start + (i === 0 ? 149 : 351)), width: 185, y: counts[i].slice(startBin, endBin),
      customdata: intervals, yaxis: lines.length ? "y2" : "y",
      hovertemplate: `Strike: %{customdata}<br>${side.name}: %{y:,.0f} contracts<extra></extra>`
    }));
    const ivLabel = curve ? `IV: TXF ${curve.futures_contract} (expires ${curve.expiry})` +
      (lines.length ? "" : " · No traded IV points in range") : (loading ? "Loading IV…" : "No TXF IV available");
    liquidityStatus.textContent = `${date} · Put ${row.Put_Volume.toLocaleString("en-US")} · Call ${row.Call_Volume.toLocaleString("en-US")} · ${ivLabel}`;
    const volumeAxis = { title: "Traded volume (contracts)", side: "left", rangemode: "tozero", tickformat: ",d" };
    ObservatoryCharts.react(liquidityChart, [...lines, ...bars], {
      barmode: "overlay", hovermode: "closest",
      xaxis: { type: "linear", title: "Strike price (500-point volume bins)", range: [first, end], tickformat: ",d" },
      yaxis: lines.length ? { title: "Implied volatility (%)", side: "right", ticksuffix: "%", showgrid: false } : volumeAxis,
      ...(lines.length ? { yaxis2: { ...volumeAxis, overlaying: "y" } } : {}),
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, yref: "container", y: 0, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "bottom" },
      margin: { b: 104 }
    }, { responsive: true, displaylogo: false, scrollZoom: false });
  }

  function sumMarketCounts(rows) {
    const daily = new Map();
    for (const row of rows) {
      const totals = daily.get(row.Date) ?? { Date: row.Date, Call_Volume: 0, Put_Volume: 0, Call_OI: 0, Put_OI: 0 };
      for (const side of ["Call_Volume", "Put_Volume", "Call_OI", "Put_OI"]) totals[side] += row[side];
      daily.set(row.Date, totals);
    }
    return daily;
  }

  function putCallPercent(put, call) {
    return Number.isFinite(put) && call > 0 ? 100 * put / call : null;
  }

  const signedPoints = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 0, signDisplay: "exceptZero"
  });
  const signedPercent = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2, signDisplay: "exceptZero"
  });
  function renderSnapshot(date, change, changePct, front, counts) {
    document.getElementById("snapshot-metrics").setAttribute("aria-label", `Market snapshot for ${date}`);
    const points = document.getElementById("snapshot-change");
    document.getElementById("snapshot-points").textContent = Number.isFinite(change) ? signedPoints.format(change) : "—";
    document.getElementById("snapshot-pct").textContent = Number.isFinite(changePct) ? `(${signedPercent.format(changePct)}%)` : "";
    points.dataset.direction = change > 0 ? "up" : change < 0 ? "down" : "";
    const percent = value => Number.isFinite(value) ? `${value.toFixed(2)}%` : "—";
    const iv = document.getElementById("snapshot-iv");
    iv.textContent = percent(front?.VIX);
    iv.title = front ? `${front.Expiration_Month} · ${front.Expiration_Date}` : "";
    document.getElementById("snapshot-volume").textContent = percent(putCallPercent(counts?.Put_Volume, counts?.Call_Volume));
    document.getElementById("snapshot-oi").textContent = percent(putCallPercent(counts?.Put_OI, counts?.Call_OI));
  }

  // Fetch volume once for both the snapshot and market history.
  const volumeData = fetch(`${rawData}/option_volume_history.csv?schema=traded-strikes`, { cache: "no-cache" })
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Option volume history unavailable");
      return response.text();
    })
    .then(parseVolumeCsv)
    .catch(error => { console.warn(error); return []; });
  const marketByDate = volumeData.then(sumMarketCounts);
  const indexData = fetch(`${rawOutput}/latest_front_vix_vs_taiex.json?fields=ohlc-change-pct`, { cache: "no-cache" })
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("TAIEX history unavailable");
      return response.json();
    })
    .catch(error => { console.warn(error); return { data: [] }; });

  Promise.all([
    fetch(
      `${rawData}/vix_term_structure_history.csv`
    )
      .then(response => {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("VIX history unavailable");
        }

        return response.text();
      }).catch(error => { console.warn(error); return ""; }),

    volumeData,
    plotlyReady,
    latestIvData(), marketByDate, indexData
  ])
    .then(([
      vixText,
      volumeRows, , latestIv, countsByDate, indexHistory
    ]) => {
      const rows =
        parseCsv(vixText);

      const allDates = [
        ...new Set(
          [...rows.map(row => row.Date), ...volumeRows.map(row => row.Date), latestIv?.as_of_date].filter(Boolean)
        )
      ].sort();

      if (!allDates.length) {
        throw new Error("No trading history rows");
      }

      slider.min = "0";
      slider.max = String(allDates.length - 1);
      slider.step = "1";
      slider.value = String(allDates.length - 1);
      slider.disabled = false;
      ivSlider.max = slider.max;
      ivSlider.disabled = false;

      for (const { select } of dateControls) {
        select.replaceChildren(...allDates.map(date => new Option(date, date)));
        select.disabled = false;
      }

      startLabel.textContent =
        allDates[0];

      endLabel.textContent =
        allDates[allDates.length - 1];
      document.getElementById("iv-start-date").textContent = startLabel.textContent;
      document.getElementById("iv-end-date").textContent = endLabel.textContent;

      let daily = [];
      let selectedIv = null;
      let ivLoading = false;
      function updateLiquidity() {
        const curve = selectedIv?.TX?.[0];
        renderLiquidity(daily.find(row => row.Expiration_Month === expirySelect.value),
          dateSelect.value, curve, daily.find(row => row.Expiration_Month === curve?.option_contract), ivLoading);
      }
      expirySelect.addEventListener("change", updateLiquidity);

      function updateFromSlider() {
        const index = Number(slider.value);
        const selectedDate = allDates[index];
        if (!selectedDate) return;

        selectedLabel.textContent = selectedDate;
        slider.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", selectedDate);
        ivSlider.value = slider.value;
        ivSlider.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", selectedDate);
        document.getElementById("iv-selected-date").textContent = selectedDate;
        for (const { select, prev, next } of dateControls) {
          select.value = selectedDate;
          prev.disabled = index === 0;
          next.disabled = index === allDates.length - 1;
        }

        const term = rows.filter(row => row.Date === selectedDate)
          .sort((a, b) => a.Days_to_Exp - b.Days_to_Exp || a.Expiration_Date.localeCompare(b.Expiration_Date));
        renderTermStructure(term, selectedDate);
        renderSnapshot(selectedDate, indexHistory.taiex_change_points?.[selectedDate],
          indexHistory.taiex_change_pct?.[selectedDate], term[0], countsByDate.get(selectedDate));

        daily = volumeRows.filter(row => row.Date === selectedDate)
          .sort((a, b) => a.Expiration_Date.localeCompare(b.Expiration_Date)
            || a.Expiration_Month.localeCompare(b.Expiration_Month));
        renderVolume(daily, selectedDate);
        const previousExpiry = expirySelect.value;
        const options = daily.filter(row => row.Call_Bins_500 && row.Put_Bins_500).map(row =>
          new Option(`${row.Expiration_Month} · ${row.Expiration_Date}`, row.Expiration_Month));
        expirySelect.replaceChildren(...(options.length ? options : [new Option("No expirations", "")]));
        expirySelect.disabled = options.length === 0;
        if (options.some(option => option.value === previousExpiry)) expirySelect.value = previousExpiry;
        function showIv(curves, loading) {
          if (selectedDate !== dateSelect.value) return;
          selectedIv = curves;
          ivLoading = loading;
          updateLiquidity();
          renderIvPanels(curves, selectedDate, loading);
        }
        if (latestIv?.as_of_date === selectedDate) {
          showIv(Object.fromEntries(["TX", "MTX"].map(product => [product,
            latestIv.products[product].curves.filter(c => c.puts.length || c.calls.length).slice(0, 2)])), false);
        } else {
          const month = selectedDate.slice(0, 7);
          if (ivMonths.has(month)) {
            showIv(ivMonths.get(month)[selectedDate], false);
          } else {
            showIv(null, true);
            loadIvMonth(month).then(days => showIv(days?.[selectedDate], false));
          }
        }
      }

      slider.addEventListener(
        "input",
        updateFromSlider
      );
      ivSlider.addEventListener("input", () => {
        slider.value = ivSlider.value;
        updateFromSlider();
      });

      function selectDay(index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= allDates.length) return;
        slider.value = String(index);
        updateFromSlider();
      }
      for (const { select, prev, next } of dateControls) {
        select.addEventListener("change", () => selectDay(select.selectedIndex));
        prev.addEventListener("click", () => selectDay(select.selectedIndex - 1));
        next.addEventListener("click", () => selectDay(select.selectedIndex + 1));
      }

      updateFromSlider();
    })
    .catch(error => {
      console.error(
        "VIX interactive chart error:",
        error
      );

      status.textContent =
        "Interactive history could not be loaded; " +
        "showing the latest static chart instead.";

      chart.innerHTML = `
        <img
          src="${rawOutput}/latest_term_structure.png"
          alt="Latest TXO VIX term structure"
          style="width:100%; max-width:960px;"
        >
      `;

      volumeStatus.textContent =
        "Option-volume history could not be loaded.";
      expirySelect.replaceChildren(new Option("No expirations", ""));
      expirySelect.disabled = true;
      liquidityChart.hidden = true;
      liquidityStatus.textContent = "Strike-volume history could not be loaded.";

      slider.disabled = true;
      for (const { select, prev, next } of dateControls) {
        select.disabled = prev.disabled = next.disabled = true;
      }
      ivSlider.disabled = true;
      renderIvPanels(null, "", false);
    });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // Four market histories share a fixed calendar window, independent of the snapshot slider.
  const lookback = document.getElementById("market-lookback");
  const windowStatus = document.getElementById("market-window-status");

  function historyLine(days, values, customdata, hovertemplate) {
    return {
      type: "scatter", mode: "lines+markers", x: days.map(row => row.Date), y: values,
      marker: { size: 4 }, customdata,
      hovertemplate: "%{x|%Y-%m-%d}<br>" + hovertemplate + "<extra></extra>"
    };
  }

  function drawHistory(id, title, axisTitle, range, trace, ratioAxis) {
    const plot = document.getElementById(id + "-chart");
    const values = trace.close ?? trace.y;
    const last = trace.x.at(-1) === range[1] ? values.at(-1) : null;
    const suffix = id === "taiex" ? "" : "%";
    document.getElementById(id + "-status").textContent = Number.isFinite(last)
      ? last.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + suffix
      : "Unavailable";
    if (!values.some(Number.isFinite)) {
      renderEmptyHistoryChart(plot, title, "No data for this period.");
      return;
    }
    // Half-day padding keeps both ends of each candle visible on the shared time scale.
    const paddedRange = range.map((day, i) =>
      new Date(Date.parse(day + "T00:00:00Z") + (i ? 12 : -12) * 3600000).toISOString().slice(0, 19)
    );
    ObservatoryCharts.react(plot, [trace], {
      title: { text: title },
      xaxis: { type: "date", range: paddedRange, tickformat: "%b %d", nticks: 5, rangeslider: { visible: false } },
      yaxis: { title: axisTitle, ticksuffix: suffix, ...ratioAxis },
      shapes: ratioAxis ? [{ type: "line", xref: "paper", yref: "y", x0: 0, x1: 1, y0: 100, y1: 100,
        line: { width: 1.5, color: "#888" }, layer: "below" }] : [],
      margin: { b: 40 }, showlegend: false
    }, { responsive: true, displaylogo: false });
  }

  Promise.all([indexData, marketByDate, plotlyReady]).then(([{ data: indexRows }, countsByDate]) => {
    const market = [...countsByDate.values()].sort((a, b) => a.Date.localeCompare(b.Date));
    const end = indexRows.filter(row => countsByDate.has(row.Date)).at(-1)?.Date;
    // If one feed is unavailable, keep the other histories usable.
    const lastDay = end ?? [indexRows.at(-1)?.Date, market.at(-1)?.Date].filter(Boolean).sort().at(-1);
    if (!lastDay) throw new Error("No market history available");

    function updateHistory() {
      const length = Number(lookback.value);
      const cutoff = new Date(lastDay + "T00:00:00Z");
      cutoff.setUTCDate(cutoff.getUTCDate() - length + 1);
      const start = cutoff.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const range = [start, lastDay];
      const inWindow = row => row.Date >= start && row.Date <= lastDay;
      const front = indexRows.filter(inWindow);
      const activity = market.filter(inWindow);
      windowStatus.textContent = `${start} – ${lastDay} · ${length} calendar days`;
      const candles = front.filter(row =>
        [row.TAIEX_Open, row.TAIEX_High, row.TAIEX_Low, row.TAIEX_Close].every(Number.isFinite)
      );
      drawHistory("taiex", "TAIEX · Daily candles", "Index points", range, {
        type: "candlestick", name: "TAIEX", x: candles.map(row => row.Date),
        open: candles.map(row => row.TAIEX_Open), high: candles.map(row => row.TAIEX_High),
        low: candles.map(row => row.TAIEX_Low), close: candles.map(row => row.TAIEX_Close),
        increasing: { line: { color: "#c44943" }, fillcolor: "#c44943" },
        decreasing: { line: { color: "#268366" }, fillcolor: "#268366" }
      });
      drawHistory("front-vix", "Front-expiry VIX", "Estimated VIX", range,
        historyLine(front, front.map(row => row.Front_VIX), front.map(row => row.Contract), "%{customdata}<br>VIX: %{y:.2f}%"));

      const ratios = [
        ["Volume", "volume-ratio", "Put/Call ratio · Traded Volume"],
        ["OI", "oi-ratio", "Put/Call ratio · Open interest"]
      ].map(([measure, id, title]) => {
        const counts = activity.map(row => [row["Put_" + measure], row["Call_" + measure]]);
        const values = counts.map(([put, call]) => putCallPercent(put, call));
        return { id, title, trace: historyLine(activity, values, counts,
          "Put/Call: %{y:.2f}%<br>Put: %{customdata[0]:,.0f}<br>Call: %{customdata[1]:,.0f}") };
      });
      const levels = [100, ...ratios.flatMap(series => series.trace.y.filter(Number.isFinite))];
      const low = Math.min(...levels), high = Math.max(...levels);
      const padding = Math.max(1, (high - low) * 0.06);
      const ratioAxis = { range: [Math.max(0, low - padding), high + padding],
        tick0: 100, fixedrange: true, nticks: 5 };
      for (const { id, title, trace } of ratios) {
        drawHistory(id, title, "Put / Call (%)", range, trace, ratioAxis);
      }
    }
    lookback.disabled = false;
    lookback.addEventListener("change", updateHistory);
    updateHistory();
  }).catch(error => {
    console.error(error);
    windowStatus.textContent = "Market history could not be loaded.";
  });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // TX / MXF IV charts
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  async function latestIvData() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${rawOutput}/latest_iv.json`, { cache: "no-cache" });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Latest IV unavailable");
      const data = await response.json();
      if (data.schema !== 1 || JSON.stringify(data.point_columns) !== '["strike","iv_pct","option_price"]'
          || !["TX", "MTX"].every(p => Array.isArray(data.products?.[p]?.curves))) return null;
      return data;
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(error);
      return null;
    }
  }

  const ivMonths = new Map();
  const pendingMonths = new Map();
  function loadIvMonth(month) {
    if (!pendingMonths.has(month)) {
      const request = fetch(`${rawData}/iv_history/${month}.json`, { cache: "no-cache" })
        .then(response => {
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`IV history unavailable for ${month}`);
          return response.json();
        })
        .then(days => { ivMonths.set(month, days); return days; })
        .catch(error => { console.warn(error); return null; })
        .finally(() => pendingMonths.delete(month));
      pendingMonths.set(month, request);
    }
    return pendingMonths.get(month);
  }

  const ivGrid = document.getElementById("iv-grid");
  const ivReset = document.getElementById("iv-reset");
  const ivPanels = [];
  for (const [product, label] of [["TX", "TXF"], ["MTX", "MXF"]]) {
    for (let rank = 0; rank < 2; rank++) {
      const panel = document.createElement("section");
      panel.className = "txo-iv-panel";
      const title = document.createElement("h4");
      const details = document.createElement("p");
      details.className = "txo-iv-details";
      const plot = document.createElement("div");
      plot.className = "txo-iv-plot";
      plot.setAttribute("role", "img");
      panel.append(title, details, plot);
      ivGrid.append(panel);
      ivPanels.push({ product, label, rank, title, details, plot });
    }
  }

  function renderIvPanels(day, date, loading) {
    ivGrid.setAttribute("aria-busy", String(loading));
    ivReset.disabled = true;
    for (const { product, label, rank, title, details, plot } of ivPanels) {
      const curve = day?.[product]?.[rank];
      const rankName = rank === 0 ? "Nearest expiry" : "Second expiry";
      title.textContent = `${label} · ${rankName}` + (curve ? ` · ${curve.option_contract}` : "");
      plot.style.visibility = curve ? "visible" : "hidden";
      if (!curve) {
        details.textContent = loading ? "Loading IV history…" : "No eligible curve available.";
        continue;
      }
      details.textContent = `Expires ${curve.expiry} · ${curve.days_to_expiry} days · Futures ${curve.forward.toLocaleString("en-US")}`;
      plot.setAttribute("aria-label", `${date}, ${label} ${curve.futures_contract} implied volatility by strike`);
      const traces = ivSides.filter(side => curve[side.key].length).map(side => ({
        type: "scatter", mode: "markers", name: `OTM ${side.name.toLowerCase()}`,
        x: curve[side.key].map(p => p[0]), y: curve[side.key].map(p => p[1]),
        customdata: curve[side.key].map(p => p[2]),
        marker: { color: side.color, symbol: side.symbol, size: 5, opacity: .85 },
        hovertemplate: `${date} · ${label} ${curve.futures_contract}` +
          "<br>Strike: %{x:,.0f}<br>IV: %{y:.2f}%<br>Option price: %{customdata:,.2f}<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>"
      }));
      ObservatoryCharts.react(plot, traces, {
        margin: { b: 70 }, xaxis: { title: "Strike price", tickformat: ",.0f", nticks: 5 },
        yaxis: { title: "Implied volatility (%)" },
        shapes: [{ type: "line", xref: "x", yref: "paper", x0: curve.forward, x1: curve.forward,
          y0: 0, y1: 1, line: { color: "#888", width: 1.5, dash: "dash" } }],
        legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, yref: "container", y: 0, yanchor: "bottom" },
        hovermode: "closest", dragmode: "zoom"
      }, { responsive: true, displayModeBar: false, displaylogo: false });
      ivReset.disabled = false;
    }
  }
  ivReset.addEventListener("click", () => {
    for (const { plot } of ivPanels) {
      if (plot.data && plot.style.visibility === "visible") {
        Plotly.relayout(plot, { "xaxis.autorange": true, "yaxis.autorange": true });
      }
    }
  });

})();
</script>
```

For detailed contract specifications and expiration dates, please refer to the [TAIFEX Futures Specs](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/2/tX) and [TAIFEX Options Specs](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/2/tXO).
